purpose: Predicts crop yield (quintal/hectare) and estimated production (quintal) based on Indian state, crop, season, soil type, cultivated area, and climatic/nutrient parameters.
output_format: Structured object containing predicted_yield (float), unit (quintal/hectare), estimated_production (float, quintals), input_summary (dict), and model_source (string)
dataset_name: India Crop Yield Dataset (Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare / DAC&FW)
known_limitations: Model artifact is ~347 MB (large binary); requires dynamic download via huggingface_hub or Git LFS rather than standard git commits.
Restricted to 28 Indian states, 50 crops, 4 seasons, and 5 soil types supported by the label encoders.
Yield is modeled in quintal/hectare; Area must be provided in hectares. Production = Yield * Area.
